description:
Superseded: the cutover target is now the separate site repo, so the steps below are owned by other items and must not be claimed from here. Steps 1 and 2 are owned by site-split-40-production-cutover. Steps 3, 4 and 6 are owned by site-split-51-publication-retirement. Step 5 is owned by site-split-54-publication-github-cleanup. This item is dropped at site-split-99, after the mapped scope has merged. The text below is kept as the original scope for reference.

After dlv2-60 shadow parity. Pre-approved admin changes (standing approvals) with G5 backups. Owner decision 2026-10-04: retirement is gated on evidence, with no elapsed-time observation window.
1. Cutover: disable old publication triggers (workflow_dispatch-only first), run site-deploy to production, verify probes and receipt, run one production rollback drill to the previous artifact and forward again.
2. Evidence before retiring: at least one green production deploy from site-deploy for each route class (release docs, dev docs, blog, results/corpus), green probes, and the rollback drill on record.
3. Retire workflows: publication-deploy.yml, publication-transaction.yml, publication-preview-deploy.yml, publication-preview-soak.yml, publication-soak-monitor.yml (*/5 cron), publication-recover.yml (*/5 cron), publication-canaries.yml (daily availability probe moves to nightly t3:site), publication-corpus-cutover.yml (after ledger shows its property covered or pure-process).
4. Retire scripts/publication/* not used by site-deploy (expected: transaction.py, transaction_executor.py, journal.py, reconciler.py, reconciliation.py, create_ledger_seed.py, acquire_canary_evidence.py, capture_baseline.py, verify_shadow_site.py, verify_lane_isolation.py, verify_release_isolation.py, verify_independence_matrix.py, check_operational_receipts.py, check_plan_reconciliation.py, check_control_plane.py, check_workflow_permissions.py, audit_mirror_prs.py, pages.cjs if superseded) plus publication/ledger-seed.json and their tests (tests/unit/scripts/publication/*, tests/unit/workflows/test_publication_*), keeping tests for reused checks.
5. GitHub: archive-tag and delete branch `publication`; delete environment publication-attestation; delete secrets PUBLICATION_APP_ID and PUBLICATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY; uninstall the publication GitHub App.
6. Docs: supersede adr-independent-publication-authorities (reference adr-dev-loop-v2); delete or rewrite docs/operations/{publication-*, independent-publication-*} and docs/development/independent-publication-threat-model.md; write docs/operations/site-deploy.md (deploy, rollback, receipts). The runbook already exists at docs/operations/site-deploy.md in this repo; see the context note.
